data.narrative:
Sunday Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Tony Zhao and Cheng Chi. The company has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe in Robotics & Manufacturing comprises one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable given the company's defined funding stage and historical capital deployed. Using total raised ($200M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $500M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable; while ten same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, the filtered peer set contains insufficient datapoints (fewer than three comparables meeting same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier criteria) to support a reliable median-based valuation.

The triangulated valuation range is $425M (low) to $575M (high), with a median of $500M. This range is supported by a single applicable method, which materially constrains confidence. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently comparable Seed-stage transactions in the sector, limiting validation of the step-up multiple applied, and the heterogeneity of business models within the broader Robotics & Manufacturing peer universe. A valuation point within the $425M–$575M band is defensible based on current data, though expansion of comparable transaction evidence would reduce range width.
